title: Redact credentials and actually export spans (VC-201-091)
goal: VC-201-091 refuted: export_spans writes attributes verbatim — an Authorization bearer token lands in the export file unredacted; Http export returns WouldPost and never transmits (correlation 'end to end' ends at the local process); OtelSpan has no status/error field so a failed request cannot be represented; file export is unbounded; no caller emits spans outside tests. Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_091_mastery.rs.
